tenderSchedule.title: Providing 01 AC Vehicles with Driver on Hire Basis for District Skill Development office, Bangalore Rural District.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing 01 AC Vehicles with Driver on Hire Basis for District Skill Development office, Bangalore Rural District.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Department For Skill Development Entrepreneurship And Livelihood
tenderSchedule.locationName: DSDEL District Skill Office Bengaluru Rural

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

DSDO, Dist Skill Development office, Bangalore rural, reserves the right to verify any information / documents furnished by the bidders, should the circumstances so warrant in the overall interest of the corporation
Part and incomplete bids, telegraphic bids, bids not accompanied by EMD and related bids will not be accepted
Dist. Skill Development officer, Bangalore rural reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the bids, without assigning any reasons thereof

All valid documents like RC Book, Tax card, Permit card, Comprehensive insurance documents, Emission test certificate And Driving licence of driver, fitness certificate, GST Certificates , RTO permission ,pan card, Police verification, etc. are to be furnished by the successful bidder at the time of entering into agreement with DSDO, Bangalore Rural

Monthly quoted rates shall be inclusive of all costs like PF charges, Service tax and all other charges hat-so-ever. The vehicle shall be made available on all the days including Sundays and general holidays during the period of contract
Non-deployment of vehicle on any day will be viewed seriously and considered as violation of Contract
Message on a metallic board indicating VEHICLE ON HIRE TO DSDO, Bangalore rural shall be displayed on the vehicle while on duty only

The successful tenderer has to provide the vehicles to DSDO, Bangalore rural on hire basis including Sundays and general Holidays, along with a suitably qualified and experienced driver with a valid transport driving license and wear uniform of stipulated colour while on duty. The DUDC, Bangalore rural shall only pay the hire charges as agreed, and tenderer has to bear all Losts such as cost of HSD, Oil Lubricants, repairs,replacement of spare parts, tyres, tubes, batteries, drivers wages AND allowances, etc

Agency / driver shall maintain the log book, issued by DSDO Bangalore rural and shall be got filled by the Driver of the vehicle from the allotters and shall get the Signature from the Authorized officer every day. The completed log book has to be surrendered to the Dist. Skill Development officer, Bangalore Rural
The agency should be a owner of the vehicle and R.C should be attested from notary and original should produce during agreement with DSDO, Bangalore rural

Any of the above terms and conditions specifically not commented on or not mentioned in the tender / price schedule, shall be construed as accepted by the agency and shall considered for incorporating the same while processing the offers for ordering

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Firm Registration / Agency Registration / GST Registration Certificate.
The tenderer shall have a Turnover of at least 5.67 lakhs in any three year of last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
The tenderer shall have an experience of at least in any three year of amount Rs 7.80 Lakhs or 1 Vehicles supplied to any Govt Department 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26
Valid Insurance Certificate of the Vehicle proposed to be provided
